submittedPrompt:
HIGHEST PRIORITY GEOMETRY: draw Shiina Taki's head STRAIGHT UPRIGHT and front-facing. Facial midline is VERTICAL; centers of BOTH EYES on the SAME HORIZONTAL LINE, cheeks at the same height. The attached style pilot has a tilted face: do NOT copy its tilt. Brows may differ slightly, the whole face must not lean. Her complete body is genuinely VERTICAL below the head, never a horizontal cat turned ninety degrees.

Create one original transparent edge companion of MyGO!!!!! Shiina Taki: a simple 2D human-cartoon head integrated with a COMPLETE WHITE meme-cat body. Use the accepted Sakiko reference only for family simplicity, crisp dark navy outline weight, flat white face, simple round two-zone eyes, head-to-body weight and the vertical body/paw support concept. Do not copy Sakiko's head, blue-purple hair, ribbons, gold eyes or smile and simply recolor them. Taki has LONG near-black / deep charcoal-brown hair, lightly diagonal grouped fringe and long broad side/back locks, clear VIOLET irises. No large invented hair ornament. Hair must remain deep charcoal rather than blue or lavender. A few broad flat warm-gray highlights can separate the hair groups. Minimal cat ears behind the hair with white inner spaces belong to this project's original cat anatomy, not an official human costume. No clothes, collar, uniform, skirt, socks or drumsticks.

Her own small story: she has been bracing a paper construction at its side, convinced one fold would not hold. The other person lets it bear its own weight and, surprisingly, it stands. She pauses, keeps her upper paw settled and loosens the lower one, acknowledging the result before saying anything. Her eyes are level toward the familiar person, clear and alert; the eyebrows hold a little focused inward gathering, but not an angry permanent V. Give her a tiny CLOSED nearly straight mouth whose ONE end has almost involuntarily lifted: a private caught smile, not a wide w-shaped smile and not the reference's expression. She is pleased with the shared attempt, not coaching or checking somebody's progress. No scowl, mature icy expression, sultry lids, blush, sweat, heart or baby surprise. The construction is outside this sprite and does not need to be drawn. Attention and slight mouth change tell the moment while her paws still relate to the same support.

Drawing language: the WHOLE head, white face, white torso, paws and tail are equally simple, graphic and integrated; no detailed anime portrait pasted onto a realistic cat. Simple round VIOLET irises, each only TWO FLAT COLOR ZONES, no glass effect, no star highlights, no eye gradients. Few dark hair blocks, flat warm-white body, clean navy contours with slight hand-drawn softness. No realistic fur, plush texture, human flesh tint, wrinkles, 3D rendering, mature makeup or ornamental costume.

Support and silhouette: body to the LEFT of one imagined vertical edge around 82 percent of the canvas width, paws curling RIGHT. The edge must NOT be drawn. One naturally attached front paw wraps that same edge beside her lower cheek, the second beside upper belly, with contact tips aligned near one vertical x coordinate. A clearly attached bent hind leg lower down ends in a paw gently bracing the same side. Shoulders, arms, belly, rump and hind leg make one complete coherent body, no spare floating paws. Body hangs down with natural slight curve, not a sideways loaf. A complete tail continuously grows from the lower rump, descends then curves down-left, whole tip visible. Long hair descends along the outer LEFT side and behind the body, keeping paw contacts unobscured and clearly distinct from the white tail. The face remains level regardless of the body's curve.

Portrait composition with transparent clearance around the entire head, ears, long hair, paws, torso, hind leg and tail; nothing cropped. No visible panel, line, ledge, ruler, rectangle, background, floor, shadow, colored halo, outer glow or fog. Genuine RGBA transparency outside only a narrow normal antialiased contour. No text, bubble, UI, border, watermark or collage. This is an original individual vertical sprite for later optional rigging.
